    "Lacks advanced project management features found in other tools.",
    "Limited customization options for workflows and reporting.",
    "May not scale well for complex projects requiring intricate task dependencies."

  "overall_experience": "This Project Manager likely found Basecamp to be a refreshing change due to its emphasis on simplicity and ease of use, which facilitated team communication and basic task management within their small furniture company.
